cobble_poke_bank.configuration.server.va: Validation Messages
Configure the validation messages for the mod.
Edit
No Held Items Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon with a held item that is not allowed.
Officially Tagged Held Items Only Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon with a held item that is not officially tagged as a held item.
Blacklisted Held Item Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon with a held item that is blacklisted.
Blacklisted Pokemon Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit or withdraw a blacklisted Pokemon.
No Legendary Pokemon Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Legendary Pokemon into their bank and Legendary Pokemon are not allowed.
No Mythical Pokemon Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Mythical Pokemon into their bank and Mythical Pokemon are not allowed.
No Ultra Beasts Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit an Ultra Beast into their bank and Ultra Beasts are not allowed.
No Fainted Pokemon Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a fainted Pokemon into their bank and fainted Pokemon are not allowed.
Auto-Stripped Held Item Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon with a held item that is not allowed and the held item is automatically stripped.
